title: The Tide of the Crescent Cove
author: Gideon Reyes
blurb: Silas Ishikawa, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
